fieldsDesc.uploadHotlink: Controls global anti-theft-link protection for uploaded files
fieldsDesc.uploadHotlinkAllowedDomains: Hostnames allowed to embed uploaded files
fieldsDesc.uploadHotlinkAllowEmptyReferer: Allow direct access when Referer and Origin headers are absent
fieldsDesc.rateLimitEnabled: Master switch for all rate limiters (takes effect immediately)
fieldsDesc.rateLimitGlobalMax: Maximum requests per window across all endpoints
fieldsDesc.rateLimitGlobalWindowMs: Window size in milliseconds for the global limiter
fieldsDesc.rateLimitAuthMax: Maximum requests per window for auth endpoints (login, signup, etc.)
fieldsDesc.rateLimitAuthWindowMs: Window size in milliseconds for the auth limiter
fieldsDesc.rateLimitTrustProxy: Comma-separated list of trusted proxies for X-Forwarded-For resolution. Supports IPs, CIDRs (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8), and keywords: loopback, uniqueLocal, linkLocal, private, all. Empty/none = trust no proxy.
fieldsDesc.currencyCreditsCurrency: Currency used to define the credit conversion rule.
fieldsDesc.currencyCreditsPerUnit: How many credits equal 1 unit of the selected currency, e.g. 1 CNY = 100 credits.
fieldsDesc.currencyLastSync: Timestamp of the last currency-rate sync.
fieldsDesc.webauthnEnabled: Allow users to sign in and register passkey credentials
fieldsDesc.webauthnRpName: Human-friendly name shown in the browser's WebAuthn prompt
fieldsDesc.webauthnRpId: Domain of the relying party (e.g. localhost, example.com). Must match the browser origin's domain.
fieldsDesc.webauthnOrigin: Full origin the browser uses to access the app (e.g. http://localhost:3000, https://example.com)
fieldsDesc.aiAgentBaseURL: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or an OpenRouter URL).
fieldsDesc.aiAgentApiKey: API key for the configured endpoint. Stored as a secret.
fieldsDesc.aiAgentModel: Model identifier understood by the endpoint (e.g. gpt-4o).
fieldsDesc.aiAgentReasoning: Reasoning effort. The model's chain-of-thought is streamed in a collapsible panel. Supported by Anthropic Claude (extended thinking), OpenAI o1/o3/gpt-5, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.
fieldsDesc.aiAgentShowReasoning: Show the reasoning panel (the model's chain-of-thought) to the user. Independent from the functional reasoning level above.
fieldsDesc.aiAgentShowToolCalls: Show the generic tool-call card (tool name, input, and output). Interactive tool cards are always shown.
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateEnabled: Master switch for the in-app self-update feature
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateSource: Release source: "github" for GitHub Releases or "manifest" for a custom JSON endpoint
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateGithubRepo: GitHub repository to check/download releases from (e.g. lisiur/platform)
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateGithubToken: GitHub personal access token for private repos or higher API rate limits
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateGithubProxy: Reverse proxy URL to accelerate GitHub asset downloads (e.g. https://ghproxy.net)
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateManifestUrl: URL to the latest release JSON manifest (required when source is manifest)
fieldsDesc.selfUpdateReleaseUrlTemplate: URL template for a tagged release, must include '{'tag'}' (e.g. https://example.com/'{'tag'}'.json)
